title: North Star Outcome Lattice and Initiative Signal Router for Quarterly Roadmaps
creator: Sofia Chen
description:
Goal: Produce a reusable artifact and lightweight service (Signal Router) that maps our company-level OKRs to live quarterly initiatives and provides a recommended re-prioritization signal for PM/ENG/Design partners.

Problem: Current roadmap planning happens in spreadsheets and slide decks. Cross-functional teams often drive parallel initiatives that drift from company outcomes because there is no single source of truth linking initiatives to prioritized outcomes and their real-time health signals (metrics, risk, burn). This causes scope churn late in the quarter and reactive reassignments that hurt delivery.

Proposal:
1) North Star Outcome Lattice - a canonical taxonomy that decomposes 3 company-level OKRs into measurable outcome nodes and the initiative types that influence them (e.g., runtime-cost, latency-slo, private-deployments). Each initiative is tagged to lattice nodes with strength (primary/secondary).
2) Initiative Signal Router - a lightweight policy engine and dashboard that ingests initiative health signals (progress %, OKR metric delta, risk score, cost delta) and emits a recommended action: maintain, accelerate, pause, or de-scope. Router outputs are surfaced to the roadmap console and a weekly PM/ENG standup digest.

Why this is different: Rather than a static mapping, the lattice + router provides dynamic, outcome-driven routing for scarce engineering capacity. It creates a clear escalation path for cross-team trade-offs tied to company outcomes.

Scope: Deliver the lattice taxonomy doc, a Miro template, a Confluence PRD, a minimal Signal Router prototype (back-end scheduler + rules), and a dashboard mock in Console. Integrations: Console metrics, Cost dashboard, and Jira/Linear linking for initiative status.
